source_text.body:
Send hotel reservation cutoff reminders from forwarded emails
Forwarded reservation emails are read by Hermes, which logs the details in Google Sheets and posts reminders to a Telegram group.
·
Oct 1, 2026
Done with
HA
Hermes Agent
What they did
For company hotel bookings, they forward reservation emails to a dedicated Hermes email account. Hermes reads the reservation details, puts the data into a Google Sheet, and then sends a Telegram group reminder three days before the cutoff date so the team can make payment.
How it went
The post presents it as an active workflow in use, but gives no numbers on volume, time saved, or failure cases.
Worth knowing
The key catch is that this depends on forwarding each reservation email into a dedicated Hermes inbox; the post gives no other setup or cost details.
Try it yourself
with
Hermes Agent
Copy prompt
When I forward you a hotel reservation email, extract the hotel name, confirmation number, dates, cost, and free-cancellation or reservation cutoff date. Log each one as a new row in my Google Sheet [sheet name], then post a reminder to my Telegram group [group name] [number] days before the cutoff. Before sending the first Telegram message, show me the row you added and the reminder text so I can confirm the format.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/hermesagent/comments/1wjm14x/what_have_you_done_with_hermes_agent_this_week
